## LendLoop — workflow 1: borrow-request notification

**Trigger:** Convex action `notifications.sendBorrowRequestNotification` POSTs here whenever a borrow request is created.

**Security:** the first Code node verifies `X-LendLoop-Signature` (HMAC-SHA256, shared secret in env `LENDLOOP_WEBHOOK_SECRET`) and throws on mismatch.

**Write-back:** after the email is sent, the workflow calls Convex `POST /n8n/notification-logged` (signed) with the stable `eventId` — Convex deduplicates on it.

**Setup:** set env `LENDLOOP_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, `CONVEX_SITE_URL` (the `.convex.site` URL); create/select an SMTP credential on the email node; set this workflow as active; in Settings set the Error Workflow to workflow 03 after importing it.
